entries.text: On a run timeout, including the hard stop, Dataproc Serverless, Athena, Athena Spark, Databricks (SQL), Starburst, Azure Synapse, Fabric Warehouse, Fabric Lakehouse, Fabric Spark and Synapse Spark now cancel the statements, calculations and batches the run started, and delete or terminate a Livy or Athena Spark session the run created; they print the cleanup warning instead of the cannot-cancel one. Snowflake, ClickHouse Cloud, Redshift and the Databricks DataFrame mode still cannot cancel work; docs/operations/run-safety.md says why. The cleanup has not been checked against live services.
